__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: The Prometheus that scrapes PSSST and loads its rules.

title: PSSST · Payment provider status
description: Declared and observed status of your payment providers, kept apart. The first rows answer who is down and who is in planned maintenance.

panels.title: Observed down
panels.description: At least one probe failing, on a fresh and valid collection.

panels.title: Declared incidents
panels.description: The provider itself announces an incident or a component that is not operational.

panels.title: Confirmed incidents
panels.description: Observed failure AND declared incident. The most reliable signal.

panels.title: Unannounced failures
panels.description: Observed failure while the official source, fresh, declares nothing.

panels.title: Maintenance in progress
panels.description: Maintenance windows open right now.

panels.title: Stale sources
panels.description: Declared source configured but without a fresh snapshot.

panels.title: Observed down
panels.description: Empty means no failure is observed.

panels.title: Declared incidents in progress
panels.description: Counted by normalized severity.

panels.title: Next announced window
panels.description: Start date published by the provider.

panels.title: Announced windows per provider
panels.description: Total announced, including windows without a date.

panels.title: Unannounced failures over time
panels.description: One line per provider, coloured while the observed failure is not announced. A gap means the condition did not hold, or was not evaluated.

panels.title: Confirmed incidents over time
panels.description: One line per provider, coloured while the observed failure and the declared incident coincide.

panels.title: Maintenance in progress over time
panels.description: One line per provider, coloured while a maintenance window is open.

panels.title: State per component
panels.description: overall is the page's rollup: any component not operational forces it to zero.

panels.title: Source freshness
panels.description: Time since the last complete and valid snapshot.

panels.title: Declared incidents by severity
panels.description: Normalized severities: none, minor, major, critical, unknown.

panels.title: Declared source reachable
panels.description: 1 when the last call produced a complete snapshot.

panels.title: Last result
panels.description: Result reported by Blackbox, independent of what the provider declares.

panels.title: Certificate expiry
panels.description: Only TLS probes feed this table.

panels.title: Probe latency
panels.description: Duration measured by Blackbox for the last collected probe.

panels.title: Last HTTP status
panels.description: Zero means no HTTP response. TLS probes produce none.

panels.title: Collection health · Our ability to measure
Blackbox collections unavailable
panels.description: PSSST cannot get a valid answer from Blackbox.

panels.title: Probes never collected
panels.description: No valid collection since startup.

panels.title: Sources never collected
panels.description: Configured source that has never produced a snapshot.

panels.title: Monitored providers
panels.description: Payment providers, acquirers and banks together.

panels.title: Blackbox collection failures
panels.description: Measures our ability to collect, not the provider's health.

panels.title: Declared source failures
panels.description: Failures to fetch the official status page.

panels.title: Probes observed failing
panels.description: Collection succeeded but the result failed: the provider, not us.

panels.title: Age of the last valid collection
panels.description: Compare with the psp_probe_stale_after_seconds threshold.
